verdict.rationale: Rive documents an MCP integration in which the Rive Editor exposes its own tools (View Models, State Machines, Layouts, Shapes) to external AI tools. That is the MCP-server role, so it does not count toward this story. Nothing in the evidence shows Rive's built-in AI agent connecting to user-supplied MCP servers to use their tools. Rive ships an AI agent, so this client-side axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes the verdict none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
